summary.bench_corpus: 5 VIVOS dev utterances, 3 trials each (15 timings)

thread_tuning.note: Default = max(cpu_count-2, 4). Empirical sweep on this 12-core box: 2→16.2s, 4→9.9s, 6→6.4s, 8→7.6s, 10→3.4–5.5s, 11→3.9s, 12→9.1s, 0(auto)→5.2s baseline. Setting cpu_count itself (12) HURT. Env var still overrides.

transcribe_flags.note: Added task='transcribe' (explicit), temperature=0.0 (disables default fallback ladder [0.0,0.2,…,1.0] that triggers on our tight compression_ratio_threshold=1.8). condition_on_previous_text=False, language='vi', beam_size=1 already set.

asr_prewarm.note: 1s silent audio fed through ASR at init; ~700 ms one-time cost; pays JIT/kernel-selection upfront so first real call hits steady-state.

silero_vad.note: Already enabled (asr_vad_filter=True). Complementary to upstream tone-energy VAD: tone-VAD rejects whole-utterance noise, silero trims intra-utterance silent gaps before the encoder.

encoder_cache_for_rerank.note: Inspected run_streaming + transcribe — no rerank re-encode path exists (single transcribe call per utterance). Nothing to cache.

summary.variance_note: p50 trial-to-trial variance is large (3897-6219 ms) due to other Windows workload during measurement. Median of 3 trials is the honest summary statistic.
